complements: inputs/MESH-MANIFEST.json (the BodyParts3D brain the game draws, same source frame); no id here repeats one there
purpose: The cortical arteries of the middle, anterior and posterior cerebral arteries and a small circle of Willis, drawn on the game's brain (owner, 18 November 2026: "let's get the vascularity right, especially with the cerebral veins and etc."). BodyParts3D 4.0 has no cerebral veins or dural sinuses; the game lays those out by hand (scene/src/ns-vessels.mjs).

source.atlas: BodyParts3D 4.0, The Database Center for Life Science (DBCLS)

rights: BodyParts3D, (c) The Database Center for Life Science licensed under CC Attribution 4.0 International (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Legacy OBJ headers (CC BY-SA 2.1 Japan) retained byte-exact.
not_included: internal carotid (FJ1682, FJ1682M) and vertebral arteries (FJ1725, FJ1725M): they run down out of the brain into the neck; drawn here they would hang below the brain as cut stumps
medial frontobasal arteries (FJ1690, FJ1690M): median 10 mm off this brain's orbital surface
splenial arteries (FJ1677, FJ1678 and mirrors), the deep perforators (lenticulostriate, thalamic, choroidal, hypothalamic) and the small cerebellar branches: inside or under the brain, never seen
cerebral veins and dural sinuses: not in BodyParts3D 4.0
